```{r}
StorageLocation <- file.path("outputs", Folder, Subset)
```

```{r}
CSVs <- list.files(OutpathLocation, pattern=".csv", full.names=TRUE)
Names <- 1:length(CSVs)
Names <- paste0(Subset, "_", Names)
```

```{r}
StatsWrapper <- function(x, y){
  Dataset <- read.csv(x, check.names=FALSE)
  Dataset <- Dataset |> select("bid", "ptype", "infant_sex", where(is.numeric))
  Dataset$ptype <- factor(Dataset$ptype, levels=c("HU", "HEU-lo", "HEU-hi"))
  Dataset$infant_sex <- factor(Dataset$infant_sex, levels=c("Female", "Male"))

  Dataset <- Dataset |>
  select(where(\(x) !is.numeric(x) || any(x != 0, na.rm = TRUE)))

  var <- Dataset |> select(where(is.numeric)) |> colnames()

  Ptype <- map(
    .x = var,   # character vector of the names to loop over
    .f = \(v) Utility_Stats(
      data = Dataset,
      var = v,
      myfactor = "ptype",
      specifiedNormality = "nonparametric"
    )
  )

  Ptype <- Ptype |> bind_rows() |> mutate(Island=y, Comparison="ptype")

  Sex <- map(
    .x = var,   # character vector of the names to loop over
    .f = \(v) Utility_Stats(
      data = Dataset,
      var = v,
      myfactor = "infant_sex",
      specifiedNormality = "nonparametric"
    )
  )

  Sex <- Sex |> bind_rows() |> mutate(Island=y, Comparison="infant_sex")

  Stats <- bind_rows(Ptype, Sex)
  return(Stats)
}
```

```{r}
DataMiningOperator <- function(x, y){
  Dataset <- read.csv(x, check.names=FALSE)
  Dataset <- Dataset |> select("bid", "ptype", "infant_sex", where(is.numeric))
  Dataset$ptype <- factor(Dataset$ptype, levels=c("HU", "HEU-lo", "HEU-hi"))
  Dataset$infant_sex <- factor(Dataset$infant_sex, levels=c("Female", "Male"))
  Dataset <- Dataset |> mutate(Island=y)

  Dataset <- Dataset |>
  select(where(\(x) !is.numeric(x) || any(x != 0, na.rm = TRUE)))

  return(Dataset)
}
```

```{r}
# data <- DataMining
# stat_hits <- StatsMining
CryingInBayesian <- function(data, stat_hits, OutPath, ...){

  StatsData <- stat_hits |> mutate(Identifier=paste(Island, marker, Comparison, sep="-"))

  TheseComparisons <- StatsData |> pull(Identifier)

  Plots <- map(.x=TheseComparisons, .f=FrequentistChild, data=data,
   internal_stats=StatsData, OutPath=OutPath)

  return(Plots)

}
```

```{r}
FrequentistChild <- function(x, data, internal_stats, theshape, thefill, OutPath, ...){
  shape_ptype <- c("HU" = 22, "HEU-lo" = 21, "HEU-hi" = 21)
  fill_ptype <- c("HU" = "white", "HEU-lo" = "darkgray", "HEU-hi" = "black")

  shape_sex <- c("Female" = 22, "Male" = 21)
  fill_sex <- c("Female" = "white", "Male" = "black")

  ThisChild <- internal_stats |> filter(Identifier %in% x)
  var <- ThisChild |> pull(marker)
  myfactor <- ThisChild |> pull(Comparison)
  ThisIsland <- ThisChild |> pull(Island)
  InternalData <- data |> filter(Island %in% ThisIsland)

  if (myfactor == "ptype"){
    theshape <- shape_ptype
    thefill <- fill_ptype
  } else {
    theshape <- shape_sex
    thefill <- fill_sex
  }

  Plot <- suppressWarnings(
    Utility_Behemoth(data = InternalData, var = var,
      myfactor = myfactor, normality = "dagostino", shape_palette = theshape,
      fill_palette = thefill, cex = 2, size = 3, corral.width = 1,
      statsHeight = 1, scalePercent = TRUE, correction = "BH", keepNS = FALSE)
  )

  Plot <- Plot + labs(title=ThisChild)

  ThePlotName <- paste0(x, ".png")
  TheFile <- file.path(OutPath, ThePlotName)
  ggsave(filename = TheFile, Plot, dpi = 600, width = 4, height = 3)

  return(Plot)
}
```

```{r}
StatsPath <- file.path(StorageLocation, "Stats")

if(!dir.exists(StatsPath)){dir.create(StatsPath)}
```

```{r}
Dataset <- map2(.f=StatsWrapper, .x=CSVs, .y=Names) |> bind_rows()
Dataset$pvalue <- as.numeric(Dataset$pvalue)
Dataset <- Dataset |> arrange(pvalue)
```

```{r}
DataMining <- map2(.f=DataMiningOperator, .x=CSVs, .y=Names) |> bind_rows()
StatsMining <- Dataset |> filter(pvalue < 0.05) |> arrange(Island, Comparison)
Here <- CryingInBayesian(data=DataMining, stat_hits=StatsMining, OutPath=StatsPath)
```

```{r}
SaveName <- paste(Subset, Folder, "Stats.csv", sep="_")
StoreAwayHere <- file.path(StatsPath, SaveName)
write.csv(Dataset, StoreAwayHere, row.names=FALSE)
```
